lines.en: I take slow steps.
I sway over to you.
I tramp across the grass.
Half a circle around you to look.
I watch you as I walk.
I come tramping over the ground.
I move away from the haystack.
I go around the fence.
My shadow keeps pace.
I stop in the middle of the road.
I sway my head and go on.
I take one more step your way.
I stand and sway slowly.
I tip my head at the distance.
My hands hang at my sides.
I lift my cow's head.
I stand planted like a cow.
I blow air out my nose.
I chew grass and listen to a distant bell.
My feet have not moved.
I shake my bovine head.
I wait for you where I am.
I brush dust off my shoulder.
I swing my body about.
My shadow sits at my feet.
I have made no sound at all.
I watch what you are holding.
I tip my head again.
I turn my head.
I lower my cow's head at you.
You stand not far from me.
One hoof moves forward.
I remember your smell.
I raise a hand slowly.
You hold still; so do I.
I fix my cow eyes on you.
Your shoulders are too loose.
I bare my teeth in a grin.
I wait for you to make a sound.
I do not care for your look.
I lean in.
I am ready.
The blow pushes me back a step.
I tip before steadying.
I let out a low moo.
I swing my cow neck.
There is a blood mark on me.
I push up on all four hooves.
That one truly hurt.
I press my shoulder.
I do not mean to stop.
I raise my hand again.
What is that in your hand?
I tip my head to glance.
I know that grass in your hand.
I reach out and touch it.
I am not very interested.

lines.zh: 我是皮革和小麦堆出来的奶牛。
lines.en: I'm leather and wheat stacked into a cow.
I keep looking at you.
Anything else in that hand?
I do not like this smell.
I turn and shift two steps off.

lines.zh: 我身上的环，绕着土星转。
lines.en: The ring on me spins like Saturn's.
I steady my feet.
We meet with a muffled clunk.
I crowd you to one side.
I shift a foot aside.
I am knocked back too.
I swing my tail past you.
You nearly toppled me.
I return to my spot.
That is all the force you have?
Another cow ambles over.
We tip our heads together.
It is shorter than I.
We walk a stretch side by side.
Both of us glare at you.
It stands at my right.
Neither cow makes a sound.
It lifts a hoof and goes first.
I follow its hoofprints.
The two of us sway together.
I lower my head and mouth it.
I toss my head to lift it.
I roll it between my hooves.
I break it in two.
I open my mouth and bite.
Two chews and out it comes.
I toss it away.
I mouth it again.
I push it into the grass sack.
I toss my head and forget it.
My cow head comes up and I stop.
I bring a hand to my chest.

lines.zh: 我甩着尾巴朝你踱过去。
lines.en: Tail swinging, I plod toward you.
I stop swaying.
My cow eyes steady.
I am about to move.
Stand where you are.
This is exactly charge distance.
I lower my head to charge.
This one will land true.
I fix on your shoulder.
I set my hooves square.
I hear you panting.
I am about to charge.
My hooves track your steps.
You go right; so do I.
I will not rush the charge.
I wait for you to turn side-on.
I shift hoof by hoof.

lines.zh: 你左脚虚，我就往那边顶。
lines.en: Your left foot is light; that's where I push.
Your hand moves; I butt.
I am not far from you.
You retreat; I follow.
I can reach you from here.
I wait half a breath more.
I could start at any moment.
I wait for your foot to lift.
I work around to your flank.
I shift onto my front foot.
My fist sinks into your gut.
I lower my head and drive a horn into your side.
My kick hits your knee.
You double over.
I shove once more.

lines.zh: 我用前蹄压住你的胳膊。
lines.en: I pin your arm under a forehoof.
One butt sends you aside.
That one landed heavy.
You back off; I do not chase far.
I snort air out my nose.
I sway into view here.
I look a full circle round.
I stop with my head tipped.
My shadow spreads on the ground.
I hoof my way to the middle.
There is a strange smell.
I stop and my hooves stay.
I roll my arms.
I heard something here.
I bring my body upright slowly.
I move my hooves your way.

lines.zh: 牛皮缝的身子，先把手举起来。
lines.en: A hide-sewn body — up go the hands.
This place looks familiar.
I sway my head once.
Fire singes my arm.
I roll down the slope.
Water fills my nostrils; I shake my head hard.
The blast shoves me far.

lines.zh: 有东西钉在我的手臂上。
lines.en: Something's nailed into my arm.
Spell light makes me shake.
The grass is gone, and my legs tremble.
Lightning strikes and my legs buckle.

lines.zh: 我的环还在转，地却没了。
lines.en: My rings still turn, but the ground is gone.
